Resolves #20963

A Main addon whose undeclared static helper reaches the Engine now fails the ESM build at the addon’s importing edge, with the specifier and the `neo.mainAddons` remedy. Declaring the helper root produces the same emitted CoreBase; an ordinary helper keeps its host module identity.

The existing plan records module reachability alongside package-owner admission and shares one cycle-safe propagation function. Main inspection runs after admission, so it cannot widen the copy set. It follows re-exports, cross-package cycles, file aliases and undeclared workspace helper chains. No second source walker or rewrite is added.

The packaging guide describes the enforced static-helper check and its remedy. Dynamic `import()` remains outside this check; the inherited gap is tracked separately in `#20978`.

Evidence: L3 achieved → L3 required (actual builds/import identity plus native Main-addon lifecycle). Residual: none.

## Deltas from ticket

- AC-3’s “neither arm” means the two **undeclared** helper arms; the explicitly declared positive arm emits its helper, as required by AC-1. [Intake clarification](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20963#issuecomment-6884912608).
- Removing the workspace traversal shortcut also lets the plan report an already-invalid App workspace edge earlier. It retains the missing-root refusal and now names the importer/specifier instead of an absolute filename.
- Restoration (`fix`): no new loader, manifest field or admission capability. `agent-preflight` is not hosted in this Engine checkout; standard commit hooks and hosted baseline guards apply.

## Test Evidence

Red-first on `dev` `05390906ea`: the real-build undeclared-helper case exited 0 instead of 1, and its plan-level counterpart failed to throw. The declared and ordinary controls passed. A partial repair was additionally falsified by a file-alias cycle and a two-hop workspace helper; both have retained regression arms.

The new behavior and existing native lifecycle coverage run in CI; the red-first and intermediate falsifiers above are local receipts. No visual acceptance is claimed by these build and lifecycle tests.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | CI-covered: the real-build `undeclared` arm refuses with the importing edge/remedy; `declared` imports the emitted addon and asserts exact CoreBase identity. Red-first receipt above is Outside-CI. |
| 2 | CI-covered: real-build `ordinary` arm asserts the unchanged host module object, value and URL. |
| 3 | CI-covered: undeclared helper files remain absent; graph controls cover ordinary cycles without package-owner over-admission. |
| 4 | CI-covered: existing Main rewrite controls in `esmDistTransforms.spec.mjs` and all eight adapter-eligible `DistEsmWorkspaceBoot.spec.mjs` cases. |

None required for this repair; published-release package acceptance remains with the parent outcome.
